Commentary.Commentary: It was a sorry bowling performance by Australia. The injury to O'Keefe didn't help their cause either. Mitchell Starc finished with four wickets but he went for aplenty as well. Now, their batsmen have to apply themselves on a testing wicket, if they want to come out of this Test match unscathed. Stay tuned for Australia's reply.

Kusal Mendis was an absolute star with the bat. He played a fabulous knock on a testing wicket and showed great maturity. Along with Chandimal and de Silva, he added vital runs and then Rangana Herath played a very handy cameo to stretch the lead beyond the 250-run mark.

Right then, Sri Lanka have challenged Australia to chase down 268 runs to win this Test match! That doesn't look like a big target but if you consider the nature of the pitch and Australia's first innings' batting against spin, then it's a very challenging one.

OUT! What a catch! Good length delivery angling away from the batsman, around off, Herath plays an uppish drive towards short extra cover where Henriques dives to his left to grab an excellent one-handed catch. That's a stunner to end Sri Lanka's innings, all out for 353!
Slightly short in length and outside off, Herath stays back, tries to cut but fails to connect.
Full in length and angling away from the batsman, Herath shoulders arms.
On a length and outside off, Pradeep plays late and places it in the gap at covers for a single. Does his job of handing the strike back to Rangana!
Back of a length ball outside leg, Herath tries his best to get bat on ball after walking across the stumps but fails to make any connection.
Goes full with his length this time but the line is once again poor. Pradeep fails to flick but it goes off his pads to fine leg for a leg bye.
Wayward delivery, short and way down the leg side, Pradeep leaves it and Nevill dives full length to collect the ball.
Third short ball in the same region, Herath gets bat on ball and pulls it down to fine leg. Only a single this time.
Short again, down the leg side, Herath fails to pull it this time. Bowling to his strength, Starc!
FOUR! Really poor bowling! Short and around leg, Herath turns inside the crease and pulls it down fine for a boundary. The lead continues to grow!
Pradeep survives! Defends a length ball on the off side to end the over. Sri Lanka lead by 260!
Bowls it on a full length and keeps it near the off stump line, Pradeep pokes at it and misses.
Length ball on middle, Pradeep defends it back to the bowler.
Down the leg side, on a full length, Herath keeps it out off the inside half of the bat to square leg and picks up a run. Pradeep has three balls to survive!
Beaten! Angles across a full ball outside off, Herath plays at it with an angled bat and gets beaten.
Very full ball on middle and leg, Herath lifts his left leg and flicks it aerially over mid-wicket. A couple of runs taken. A frustrating stand this for the Aussies!
Chane of ends for JOSH HAZLEWOOD!
Misses the leg stump by a whisker! Pradeep makes room by moving on the leg side and Starc follows him with a fuller length ball. Pradeep swing and misses and is lucky to be still out there.
Nearly chops it on! Starc comes from over the wicket and bangs in a short ball around leg, Pradeep goes for the pull shot but inside edge it onto his boot. It goes very closely past the leg stump.
FOUR! Starc is leaking too many runs! Steven Smith is not looking happy! A full ball angling into the batsman, Pradeep stays back and just steers it through point for another boundary.
FOUR! Runs are flowing and the lead goes past 250! Short of a length ball outside off, Pradeep hops a bit and glides it over the slip cordon for a boundary.
Digs in a short ball on middle, Herath plays a miscued pull shot to mid-wicket for a single.
A nasty bouncer from round the wicket, Herath tries to pull but it whizzes past his gloves to the keeper.
This is very smart batting from the veteran. He quietly taps a full ball to cover-point and crosses for a run.
FOUR! Connects and connects well this time. Handy runs for Sri Lanka. Tossed up ball on off, Herath goes down on one knee and reverse sweeps it wide of backward point for a boundary.
Flighted and wide outside off, Herath gets forward and plays well away from the line. He keeps his bat near his pads and then allows it through.
Flatter around off, Pradeep goes back to defend but it takes the outside edge and rolls towards third man for a single.
Tossed up ball outside off, Herath tries to play the reverse sweep but misses. Nevill fails to stop it and they cross for a bye.
FOUR! Easy runs! Tossed up ball around leg, Herath top edges his attempted sweep shot to the fine leg region for a boundary.
NATHAN LYON is into the attack.
Starc comes from round the wicket for the new batsman and attempts to spear in a yorker. But he fails to land it and ends up slipping a full toss on off, Pradeep keeps it out to covers.
NUWAN PRADEEP is the last batsman.

OUT! Sandakan plays it on! Starc bangs in a short ball again, 142 kph, following the batsman down the leg side, Sandakan tries to fend it away on the leg side but it takes the inside edge, hits him on the groin and then goes on to tickle the stumps. Starc smiles!
Steven Smith has a chat with his bowler.
Starc switches to the short pitch bowling, around off, Sandakan flashes and misses.
And here it comes, a yorker in the line of the stumps, 143 kph, Sandakan digs it out at the last moment.

FOUR! Lucky boundary! Vital runs for Sri Lanka! Short in length and outside off, Sandakan makes room to once again slam it over point but this time it catches the top edge and balloons over the slip cordon for a boundary. It seems Starc is setting him up for a yorker.
FOUR! Nicely played! Starc digs in a short ball on middle, Sandakan probably anticipates it, he makes room on the off side and slams it over point for a boundary.
Width on offer outside off, Sandakan goes after it and slices it behind backward point for a single.
Fuller in length on off, pushed back to the bowler.
LAKSHAN SANDAKAN walks in next.

OUT! THE DECISION STAYS AS IT IS! Full in length angling into the batsman, around middle and leg, Perera walks forward and across to flick it on the leg side but misses and is hit on the pads. They appeal and the finger goes up. Perera opts for the review but the replays show that it's clipping the leg stump. He has to walk back and Australia strike straight after the break.
We're back. The rain has eased away and we are all set to resume. The players are back on the field. Hazlewood to complete his over.
DAY 4, SECOND SESSION...

There is no improvement in the conditions and hence the umpires have called for an EARLY LUNCH. The 1st session lasted for a minuscule 7.3 overs before rain stopped play. However, its impact is not to be underestimated as the Aussies got the big wicket of Kusal Mendis. Rangana Herath has made a quick cameo to stretch the Lankan lead to 228. Hopefully, the rain will break soon and we can see a resumption in play after Lunch. Do join us in a short while.

RAIN STOPPAGE! The rain is hardly visible but it has gotten very gloomy out there. Once again, the umpires make the call and signal for the covers to be brought back on. The players trudge back to the shelter of their dressing rooms. Stay tuned for further updates.
Length ball outside off, defended through point for a single.
Short ball outside off, left alone.
Full around off, Perera looks to defend it but is hit on the pads.
FOUR! Short ball on middle, pulled through backward square leg for a boundary. Herath is adding vital runs to the lead here.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. Two runs added to the total.
Once again it's down the leg side but Herath fails to get any wood behind it.
Sliding down the leg side, Perera nudges it to fine leg for a run.

FOUR! Length ball outside off, the ball has pace and bounce and all Perera has to do is get back off the back foot, open the face of his bat and guide it to third man. The lack of a fielder there sees the ball go all the way to the fence.
Fuller outside off, defended to the leg side. It appears that the ball isn't swinging back in enough. Might be a cause of frustration for the bowler.
Angles across a length ball outside off, Herath shoulders arms.
Another back foot defense offered by Herath.
Length ball outside off, Herath defends it from the crease.

NOT OUT! It pitched outside leg. A touch shortish ball and Herath fails to work it around the corner. He is hit high on the pads, they appeal and the umpire raises his finger. Herath takes the DRS and the replays show that it was pitching outside leg. No need to look further then.
Herath has been adjudged lbw! He is reviewing it. Looks high to the naked eye, let's see...

In the air..... Short ball on middle, Herath looks to pull it but the ball takes a top edge and is airborne. It flies behind the stumps and the fine leg and slip fielders both chase after it. The batsmen take a couple.
Herath opens the face of his bat to play through the line but it goes off the outside edge through gully and backward point and all the way to the ropes.
Sharp length ball in the channel outside off, Perera has an easy leave.
Going down the leg side, Perera fails to get any bat behind it.
Good follow up delivery! Starc follows up his bouncer with a pacey full ball in the line of the stumps, 145 kph. Perera is equally up to the challenge and pushes it out to the covers.
The batsman does well to leave that bouncer.
Full ball around off, Perera looks to drive it, but gets an inside edge and goes to square leg. The batsmen run two.
Quicker delivery outside off, Perera lets it through.
Back of a length and outside side off, Herath chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
FOUR! Edged away! Length ball on middle, slightly straighter delivery, Herath flicks it away through fine leg and the ball races to the boundary. Hazlewood pays for his moment of frustration.
Fuller ball on the stumps, blocked off the back foot back to the bowler.
Length ball around off, defended to mid-wicket.
Good length delivery and whistling past the off stump, Herath is cramped back and wisely decides to leave it.
Length ball outside of and swinging away, Herath looks to play it but misses.
Angles across a length ball outside off, Perera has a gentle push inside the line but misses. Impressive over by Starc!
Wrong line, on a back of a length but down the leg side, Perera tries to glance but misses.
Bowls it full and around middle, 148 kph, Perera defends it off his pads to mid-wicket.
Back of a length ball on off, Herath turns it through square leg for a single.
Good length ball on off, Herath defends it off his back foot.
RANGANA HERATH is the new batsman.

OUT! EDGED BEHIND AND CAUGHT! Starc catches the big fish! Back of a length delivery outside off, Mendis looks to push it to the off side but the ball nicks the outside edge. It travels to the keeper who has to hop to his right to catch that sitter. And just like that, Sri Lanka's star batsman misses out on his double century. SRI LANKA NOW LEAD BY 204 RUNS!
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Lands it full and on off, Mendis drives it to mid off.
Bowls it full and on off, Mendis drives it through covers for a couple of runs. The outfield is quite slow due to all the rain and hence the ball failed to cross the boundary line.
Hurls a length ball outside off, it's left alone.
Chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Full in length on off, Mendis gets forward and defends it back.
JOSH HAZLEWOOD to bowl from the other end.
Outside off, left alone.
Down the leg side, Perera looks to flick it but is struck on the pads. The keeper collects it and there is a stifled appeal but nothing from the umpire.
Fuller ball down the leg side, Mendis looks to flick it but the ball is deflected off his pads to backward square leg and the umpire signals a leg bye.
FOUR! Full and wide outside off, Mendis goes for the cover drive but gets an outside edge through slips and gully for a boundary. Sri Lanka lead by 200 runs!
Fuller delivery outside off, pushed through the covers.
Good start for the Aussies! On a length and outside off, Mendis looks to block it with a straight bat but the ball swings away and he misses.

GOOD NEWS! Luckily, that was quite a short delay. The covers are off and the players are on the field. Kusal Perera and Dilruwan Perera are the overnight batsmen. Mitchell Starc to steam in with the second NEW BALL...

Oh dear! We looked to be on the verge of starting today's play and the rain has played spoilsport once more. Steven Smith and the rest of his team came trooping down the steps with the umpires leading the way but suddenly there is some drizzle in the air. A local umpire halts the procession and, seeing the conditions, gestures for the centre cover to be brought back on. The players are forced to head back, but it does not look too serious out there but enough to delay the resumption of play.

PITCH REPORT - It has not started to crumble yet but it is bone dry. Spinners will have a say and there are some interesting marks around the batsman's area. However, if the technique is good, the batsmen can survive.
Hurrah! The covers are being removed and the conditions are slightly getting better. PLAY TO START AT 1045 IST (0515 GMT).

COVERS ARE ON THE GROUND. We are in for a delayed start because of an early morning shower. However, the rain has stopped, albeit it is looking very overcast. The players are currently practising out in the middle. Hopefully, we will resume soon.

The pitch has begun to look more batting friendly and we can hope to see some interesting cricket today. Australia have more than their fair share of power-hitters, however, the Lankans have already proven their bowlers can keep the runs down. Stay tuned as we take you through today's action.

Hello and welcome to Day 4 of the Test between Sri Lanka and Australia. It's been a dramatic turn around for the Lankans as Kusal Mendis' 169 has given them a useful lead. With four wickets in hand, they will look to extend it further and set a challenging target for the visitors.
...Day 4, Session 1...

Despite the weather interruptions, this Test has shaped up nicely for a cracking finish. Hope you enjoyed our coverage of the day's play. Tune in at 0945 IST tomorrow for the day 4 action. Until then, it's goodbye from us.

It didn't look that rosy at the start of the day for the hosts as Dimuth Karunaratne and Angelo Mathews both fell cheaply as Sri Lanka were 4 down after just having cleared the first innings deficit. However, Mendis' masterclass meant that the hosts are now with a great chance of winning this Test as batting last will not be easy. The Aussie bowlers had a patchy day with nobody really bowling a great spell while a couple of close chances went down too. O'Keefe's absence did hurt Smith's plans as well. The first session tomorrow will be crucial.

For the first time we had play after tea in this Test but we couldn't get in a full day's quota yet again. Bad light meant that play got stopped 10 overs after tea and since then, the conditions never improved with the rain having the final say. Surely Sri Lanka's day as they got their lead very close to the 200-run mark riding on a high quality unbeaten ton from Kusal Mendis with some support from Dinesh Chandimal and Dhananjaya de Silva. The second session gave Sri Lanka immense momentum as runs came freely.
1655 IST - The expected news has come out. PLAY HAS BEEN CALLED OFF FOR THE DAY.
1640 IST - It has started to drizzle now and the covers are brought on. Chances of play resuming looks very bleak. Stay tuned for latest updates.

1600 IST - Bad light has stopped play! The third session is threatened yet again. It is not the rain this time but the bad light which has halted the game. There was a bit of discussion in between the overs as Australia wanted to take the new ball and bowl with Starc and Hazlewood. But the umpires feel that the light is not good enough for fast bowling. The light meter is out, they check the readings and then give the marching orders to the players. Stay tuned for further updates.

Serves it on the pads, worked to the leg side.

What a ball to start with! Tossed up ball on off, it spins after pitching. Mendis pads it away. There are loud appeals but the umpire is unmoved. The replays show it was pitched outside off and was spinning away.
STEVEN SMITH will roll his arms.
FOUR! Lucky! Loopy ball on off, Perera looks to defend. The ball gets an inside edge and it goes to the fence behind the stumps.
Tossed up ball on off, swept through square leg for a single.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Dilruwan Perera will bat next.
200th Test wicket for Nathan Lyon.

OUT! de Silva holes out! Tossed up ball outside off, de silva kneels and goes for a loft over mid off. However, it is not timed properly and the elevation goes wrong. Khawaja out there takes a catch. de Silva gives away his wicket just before the new ball was due. A good 71-runs stand is broken. Lyon takes his 200th Test wicket.
Serves it on off, de Silva off the back foot plays it to covers.
Tossed up on off, Mendis pushes it gently through covers for a single.
Good length ball on off, de Silva comes forward and pushes it to covers.
Good length ball on middle and leg. de Silva goes back and plays it to mid on.
Good fuller ball on the pads, de Silva tucks it to square leg for a brace.
Serves it on the legs, de Silva flicks it to mid on.
Tad fuller ball on middle and leg, de Silva confidently plays it to the leg side.
Length ball on off, de Silva pushes it to covers.
Tad short on the pads, Mendis tries to flick it and does so to the leg side.
Serves it on off, Mendis neatly defends it.
Loopy ball on the pads, Mendis flicks it to the leg side.
Tad short ball outside off, de Silva gets back and punches it through to covers. The fielder puts in a good dive and saves a run. Three runs taken.
Serves it on off, de Silva plays it to the off side.
Loopy ball on off, de Silva gets back and blocks it.
What a shot there! Serves it full on middle, Mendis drives it back to the bowler through mid on. Warner chases it down and saves a boundary. Brace taken. The shot was a classical one.
Tad fuller, angling in. Mendis plays it with the full face of the bat to the off side.
Good length ball on off, pushed off the front foot.
FOUR! Pulled away! Back of a length ball on middle and leg. Mendis gets over the ball and rides the bounce to beautifully pull it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Tad fuller ball, angling in. Mendis pushes it to mid on.
Good length ball outside off, angling in. Mendis off the front foot blocks it.
Serves it on off, defended watchfully.
Loopy ball on off, de Silva off the front foot defends it.
Another short ball on middle, Mendis confidently plays it through mid-wicket for a single.
Tad short ball on middle, de Silva goes back and pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up ball on the pads, de Silva gets back and tucks it to short fine leg.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Good length ball on off, angling in. Mendis with a confidence defends it.
Full ball outside off, left alone.
Fuller ball, nipping in. Mendis off his front foot blocks it.

Tossed up ball outside off, defended off the front foot.

Serves it full on middle, Mendis flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Fligthed ball on the pads, flicked to the leg side.
Tossed up ball on off, de Silva gets back and tucks it to the leg side for a single.
NATHAN LYON to bowl from the other end.
Tad fuller ball on off, pushed to covers.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Length ball on middle and leg, flicked to the leg side for a single.
Fuller ball on off, defended neatly.
Cheeky! Short ball outside off, de Silva looks at it and plays a late cut through vacant slip cordon. Why there is no slip fielder? Australia gone defensive. Brace taken.
Short ball on off, de Silva hops and defends it to the ground.

Welcome back. Mendis and de Silva will look to carry on with their partnership in this final session. Mitchell Marsh will begin with the bowling proceedings. The forecast looks pretty intense as there are black clouds hovering. We hope they stay away. Here we go...
...Day 3, Session 3...

Australia did have a couple of chances - both return catches that were put down. Starc's was relatively easier while Hazlewood got a tough one that was spilled. O'Keefe's injury meant that the tourists were a bowler short in the session. The pacers did get some reverse swing but couldn't be on target consistently. Lyon disappointed as he struggled to find his radar. The hosts will want to push the lead further on a track that seems to be getting better although you do need to graft for runs. Join us in a short while for the final session.

Sri Lanka's session again as the hosts rattled up 137 runs in the 32 overs bowled after lunch. Mendis was the highlight yet again as he got to his maiden Test ton and went further to get past the 150-run mark as the Lankans attacked the Aussie bowlers. Chandimal gave good support to Mendis before the former departed to Marsh. However, de Silva has hung around well and along with Mendis, have pushed the lead past the 165-run mark.

FOUR! NO THEY CAN'T! Stunning stroke! Flatter and short outside off, Mendis stays back to that one and bunts it through wide mid off as the ball rockets to the fence for a boundary. THAT SHALL BE TEA ON DAY 3.
Last ball before tea coming up. Can Australia sneak one before the break?
Quicker ball on a length outside off, pushed off the back foot to extra cover for a single.
Fuller outside off, Mendis sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.
Slider on off, Kusal stays back and works it to the leg side.
Flatter on middle and leg, blocked off the back foot to forward short leg.
FOUR! POOR BALL! A bit short outside off, Mendis rocks back and punches it sweetly through point as the ball rockets to the fence for a boundary. 150 up for Mendis, what a knock! Truly brilliant!
Last over before tea coming up.
Fullish on off, nicely dug out towards the covers.
Back of a length on leg stump, tucked to square leg for a brisk single.
Fuller on middle and leg, clipped down to fine leg for a single.

Flatter outside off, defends it well off the front foot.

Slider outside off, Silva presses forward and blocks it out.
Flatter outside off, blocked off the back foot to the covers.
FOUR! TOP SHOT! Floats it up outside off, Silva steps out to that one and crunches it through wide mid off for a boundary. That was struck really well and negotiated the turn well.
Fuller on off, Mendis slog sweeps it through mid-wicket for a single.
Good length outside off, steered towards point with soft hands
Pitched up outside off, blocked off the front foot to the covers.
Length ball on leg stump, Kusal goes across and flicks it stylishly through backward square leg for a single.
Very full and outside off, Mendis jams it through the covers for a brace.

ANOTHER CHANCE GOES DOWN! Fuller outside off, Mendis drives it hardly back at Hazlewood who spills a sharp return chance on his followthrough as the ball parries to mid off. Tough chance but such opportunities can make or break a game.
Good length angled in on off, pushed off the front foot down the track to the bowler.
Loopy on middle and off, turns in a bit with extra bounce as Silva jabs it to forward short leg.

Drifting away outside off, defended well off the front foot on to the track.
Drifting in a bit short outside off, punched off the back foot through the covers for a brace.

Hurls it a bit fuller ball on off, de Silva gets ahead and gently pushes it to mid off.

Tad fuller ball on middle and off, Mendis stays tall and cuts it to covers for a single.
Tad short ball outside off, pushed to covers for a single.
Length ball on off, de Silva gets ahead and defends it.

Good length outside off, blocked off the back foot to the leg side.

Fuller on off, swept away down to fine leg for a single.

Floats it up outside off, swept away to short fine leg.
NATHAN LYON is back on.

Four Leg byes! Good length drifting on to the pads, Kusal misses the flick as the ball rolls off the pads down to the fine leg fence. Not off the bat but SL won't mind as long as the lead keeps swelling.
Good length outside off, Mendis gets back and pushes it through point for a brace.
Partnership between Chandimal and Mendis is now 100.
Pitched up on middle and off, Chandimal goes across and pushes it towards mid on for a single. LEAD IS NOW 100.
Pitched up on middle and off, tailed in as Chandimal digs it out.
Short and wide outside off, cut away to deep point for a single.
Full and tailing in from around off, pushed off the front foot towards mid on.
Drinks are on the field...
Two Leg byes! Good length drifting in on leg stump, Chandimal misses the flick as the ball rolls off the pads to fine leg. A couple of leg byes taken.

FOUR! POOR BY STARC! Length ball down the leg side, erratic stuff and Chandimal gets across to glance it down to the fine leg fence for another boundary. Australia are under some pressure due to this pair.
Good length outside off, defended well off the front foot.

FOUR! SLAPPED! Short and wide outside off, Chandimal is now shifting gears as he upper cuts over backward point to the third man for a boundary. Aggression now from the Lankans as the runs are coming freely.
Fuller on middle and leg, clipped through backward square leg for a brace.

DROPPED! How difficult was that? Not that much as replays showed. Length ball angled in from around off, Chandimal goes across to flick it away but gets a leading edge down the track. Starc on his followthrough sticks out his right hand but the ball didn't stick as the ball goes to the leg side. He should have gone at it with both hands perhaps. Huge reprieve for Dinesh.
Length ball outside off, Mendis leans into it and pushes it to the covers.
Pitched up on off, tailing in as Kusal digs it out to short mid-wicket. There are 2 fielders at short mid-wicket near each other.
Pitched up on middle and leg, Marsh is looking for the lbw but is getting it too straight as Mendis clips it sweetly through mid-wicket for a brace.
Fuller on middle and leg, worked away down to fine leg for a brace.
FOUR! TOP STROKE! Full and tailing in from around off, a nonchalant whip across the line by Mendis over mid-wicket as the ball goes to the fence for a boundary. Lovely stroke that!
Good length around off, defended from the crease by getting right behind the line.
MITCHELL MARSH comes on for the first time in this innings.
Good length angled in from outside off, defended off the front foot towards short mid-wicket.
Good length outside off, Chandimal goes back to open the bat face but gets it on the bounce towards first slip.
Short ball on off, Chandimal ducks under it.
Fullish around off, once again well defended off the front foot.
Length ball around off, Dinesh defends it well off the front foot.
Good length on middle and leg, worked to the leg side.
Flatter on outside off, Mendis drives and the ball goes off the edge to point.
Fuller outside full outside off, drilled down to long off for a single.
Floats it up outside off, Chandimal blocks it from the crease.
Full and outside off, driven back to the bowler.
Flatter on off, Chandimal goes to drive and mistimes it back to the bowler.
Too full outside off, dug out down the ground to long off for a single.
ADAM VOGES will continue to bowl from O'Keefe's end.
Fullish and tailing in from around off, Chandimal plays across the line a bit early and gets the leading edge to mid off.
Good length outside off, Chandimal defends it well off the front foot.
Length ball angled in from around off, pushed back at the bowler down the track.
Short ball around off, Dinesh ducks under the bumper.
Good length outside off, pushed off the front foot towards cover.
Length ball angled in from outside off, straightens a bit after pitching as Chandimal is beaten on the push.
Drifting in from outside off, Mendis pushes at it as the ball goes off the outer edge towards point.
Loopy and outside off, Mendis reaches out and defends it solidly to the off side.
Drifting in from outside off, pushed off the front foot to short cover.
A bit short outside off, cut away towards sweeper cover for a single.
This is bad news for Australia. O'Keefe is leaving the field with a sore hamstring. He had been struggling for a while now and this had to come. ADAM VOGES to complete the over.
Flatter on middle and leg, worked through mid-wicket for a single. O'Keefe continues to struggle with his hamstring.
Fuller outside off, driven through mid off for a single.
STEPHEN O'KEEFE is back on.
Short of a length on off, angled in  as Chandimal works it off the back foot through mid-wicket for a single.
Length ball slanting in from outside off, Chandimal pushes at it with soft hands as the ball goes off the outer half towards gully.
Good length angled in from outside off, solid front foot defense by Dinesh.
Fuller outside off, Chandimal drives it back at the bowler.
Good length outside off, steered towards point for a single.

FOUR! CREAMED! Full and angling in from outside off, a sublime straight drive from Mendis back past the bowler down the ground to the fence for a boundary. O'Keefe gave a tired chase and gave up eventually, possibly looking a bit ginger in his hamstring.
MITCHELL STARC is on for another spell. He'll start off from around the wicket.
Flighted outside off, blocked solidly from the crease.
Floats it up on middle and leg, Kusal goes across and sweeps it down to fine leg for a single.
Fuller on off, swept away down to fine leg for a single.
Drifting in around off, Chandimal steps out to push at it but the ball goes off the pads to the covers.
Sliding in on off, a touch short as Mendis pulls it away towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Floats it up on middle and leg, Kusal reaches out and blocks it out well.
Length ball angled in from outside off, blocked solidly from the crease down the track.
Back of a length on off, pulled off the back foot to deep mid-wicket for a single. Brings up the 150 for SL, lead is now 64.
Dug in short around off, well-directed bumper as Kusal evades it by swaying away.
Good length around off, blocked off the back foot to the off side.

FOUR! SENSATIONAL SHOT! Full outside off, a juicy half volley alright but the execution is what made this stroke special. Mendis drives it beautifully dead straight back past the bowler down the ground to the fence for a boundary.
Good length angled in from around off, defended solidly off the back foot.
Fuller outside off, defended well off the front foot.
Fuller on off, Chandimal goes across and sweeps it to the leg side.
Drifting in around off, Dinesh steps out and blocks it out.
Floats it up outside off, Chandimal goes across and sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for a brace.
Floats it up on off, Mendis goes across and works it to short fine leg for a single.
Floats it up on middle and leg, worked off the back foot to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Length ball on off, Chandimal gets across and blocks it out.
Fuller and outside off, defended well off the front foot to the covers.
Length ball outside off, nips in sharply to rap Mendis on the pads as the ball rolls to the keeper. Impact outside the line.
Pitched up just outside off, angled in as Chandimal blocks it well off the front foot.
Length ball outside off, Mendis gets back and powers it through point for a single.
Good length on middle and leg, clipped down to fine leg for a single.
Maiden Test ton for Kusal Mendis. He is the youngest Sri Lankan to score a century against Australia. Meanwhile, the 50-run stand has also come up with that stroke - a vital one for the hosts.

SIX! BANG! WHAT A WAY TO REACH THE LANDMARK! Floats it up outside off, Mendis goes down on one knee and slog sweeps it powerfully over deep mid-wicket for a maximum to reach the three-figure mark. Brilliant knock from the young man. Top quality!
Floats it up on off, Chandimal uses his feet and tucks it through
Drifting in from outside off, Mendis gets across and sweeps it towards backward square leg for a single.
Fuller on off, swept away towards deep square leg for a single.

FOUR! CLEVER FROM CHANDIMAL! Floats it up around off, Dinesh gets well across and paddles it fine down the leg side past the keeper to the fence for a boundary. Deft touch from the Lankan vice captain.
Floats it up on off, Chandimal goes back to flick but the extra bounce sees the ball rebound off the thigh pad to forward short leg.
NATHAN LYON comes on to bowl.
Fullish on off, tails in a bit as Kusal blocks it by covering the movement towards forward short leg.
Length ball just outside off, tight from Hazlewood and Mendis responds with a good leave.
Fuller and around off, driven firmly back to the bowler.
Short of  a length outside off, Mendis stays back and slaps it through the covers to the deep for a brace.
Good length outside off, smartly left alone to the keeper.

FOUR! TOP STROKE! This has been a high quality knock so far. Back of a length on middle and leg, Mendis gets back to that one and clips it away through mid-wicket with lovely timing to find the fence. Moves into the 90s.
Slider outside off, Dinesh stays back and blocks it out.
Flighted outside off, a bit of extra bounce as Chandimal rides it a bit awkwardly with soft hands towards the off side.
Floats it on a length outside of, Chandimal taps it off the back foot to cover.
Loopy on off, drifting in as Chandimal defends it with a dead straight bat back to the bowler.
Drifting away outside off, Chandimal presses forward and blocks it out.
Floats it up on off, worked off the back foot to deep backward square leg for a single.
Fuller on middle and leg, Chandimal shuffles across to much and misses the flick as he is rapped on the pads. Stifled lbw appeal but that was probably missing leg.
Length ball outside off, Chandimal hangs back to that one and blocks it.
Good length outside off, defended well from the crease towards short cover.
Length ball outside off, left alone to the keeper.
Fuller and tailing in from around off, worked with the swing towards mid-wicket.

THAT WAS CLOSE! Length ball around off, nipping in a touch as Chandimal plays across to that one and is rapped on the pads. Loud, loud appeal for lbw but turned down. Looked very close! Was there an inside edge? Replays don't seem to show it but perhaps the impact was slightly outside the line.
JOSH HAZLEWOOD to bowl from the other end after the break.
Too full outside off, dug out towards the covers.

Fired down the leg side, Chandimal goes across to flick but misses as the ball rolls off the pads past the keeper down to fine leg. Three leg byes taken. No signal from the umpire so there must have been some bat.
Drifting in from around off, Chandimal gets forward and blocks it with a straight bat.
Darts it on leg stump, Mendis gets back and works it through mid-wicket for a single.
Flighted outside off, Kusal defends it well off the front foot to cover.
Fuller on off, Mendis blocks it out well.

Welcome back for the second session. This is going to be a huge passage of play in the context of the match. Chasing isn't going to be easy at all on this track although it's not a raging turner. KUSAL MENDIS and DINESH CHANDIMAL are set to resume their stand. It shall be STEPHEN O'KEEFE to start proceedings after lunch.
.....DAY 3, SESSION 2.....

The star of the morning session, Kusal Mendis is playing a brilliant innings on a challenging wicket and he is nearing his maiden century. Chandimal is providing a good support from the other side too. The Australians bowled well and claimed 3 wickets in the session. Their spinners in particular were terrific and kept the batsmen on the back foot. However, they will look to take quick wickets after the break. It promises to be an interesting next session, do join us in a bit.

That was Sri Lanka's session as they scored more than 100 runs in it but Australia still have the upper hand as the lead is only 30 runs at the moment. The lead is crucial from the hosts point of view as this pitch is turning a lot and anything around 100-150 will be challenging.

Not out says the umpire! Tossed up ball on middle and leg, Chandimal looks to play that with the full face of the bat but gets beaten. The ball hits the pads. The appeal is made but it is yet again turned down. The umpire feels it was pitching outside leg. THAT'S LUNCH ON DAY 3!
Loopy ball on middle and it is worked to mid-wicket.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot
Bowls it on middle and leg, Mendis plays it to the leg side for a single.
Serves it on middle and leg, Chandimal gets back and flicks it to short fine leg for a single.
Tossed up ball on off, Chandimal tries to sweep but gets hit on the pads.
That was a ripper! The batsman looks to block it but is beaten.
Serves it full on off, pushed to covers for a single.
Tossed up ball on off, defended well in front of the wicket.
The batsman plays a pull shot to this short delivery. The batsmen have run through for a single.
FOUR! Two in two! Another short ball outside off, Mendis is well-balanced out there and he uses his feet to go back. It is pulled through mid-wicket for a boundary.
FOUR! Punished! Short ball on off, Mendis gets back and pulls it through mid-wicket to welcome Warner.
David Warner to bowl. That is a surprise move.
Tad fuller on middle. Chipped to short fine leg for no runs.
On middle and leg, played to square leg for a single.
The batsman plays a sweep shot. One run added to the total.
On the pads yet again, Chandimal sweeps it through square leg for a brace.
Serves it on the pads, Chandimal looks to sweep but misses.
Tossed up ball on off, Chandimal tries to flick that away but gets hit on the pads.
FOUR! Good flick! Tossed up ball on middle and leg, Mendis gets back and flicks it through mid-wicket for a racy boundary.
Loopy ball on off, Mendis gets ahead and plays it to the off side.
On the pads, worked to the leg side.
Serves it on off, Mendis gets underneath it and fends it.
Loopy ball on off, pushed to covers.
Darts it on off, defended watchfully.
Serves it on the pads, played to the leg side.
Tossed up ball on off, Chandimal plays a good solid defense.
Serves it on off, played to the off side.
Loopy ball on the pads, worked to mid on for single.
Floats in on off, defended to the off side.
Serves it on off, worked to the leg side.
On the pads, Mendis sweeps it to square leg for a single.
Darts it on off, driven to mid off for a single.
Tad full on off, blocked.
Loopy ball outside off, Chandimal defends it to the off side.
Serves it on off, defended neatly.
Tossed up ball on off, played to covers.
Loopy ball on off, swept to the leg side.
Serves it on the pads, worked to the leg side.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Leg bye. Another attempted sweep on that outside off ball but it goes of the pads. Leg bye taken.
Loopy ball on off, defended neatly.
Tossed up ball on off, Mendis tries to sweep but misses. The ball hits him on the pads.
BEATEN! Floats it up outside off, Mendis hangs his bat at it and is beaten by the slider.

POOR REVIEW! Floats it up around leg, turns away sharply to rap Mendis on the pads as he misses the push off the front foot. Loud lbw appeal and looked close but turned down. Australia opt for the review. Looked plumb on impact but where did it pitch? Hawk Eye shows it's pitching just outside leg stump and that dismissed the case straightaway after no inside edge was detected. So, Australia too have lost both their reviews.
Australia are reviewing an lbw call against Mendis.
Fuller on middle and off, Kusal reaches out to block it out.
Fuller on off, Mendis reaches out to that one.
Fullish on middle nad leg, Mendis presses forward and defends it.
Flatter on leg stump, Mendis gets back and dabs it to short leg.
Tossed up ball on the pads, played to the leg side.
The batsman has swept that one through the leg side. One run added to the total.
Tossed up ball outside off, Mendis plays a reverse sweep for a brace through slip cordon.
The batsman works it down the leg side.

Close shout! Tossed up ball on middle. Mendis goes for a sweep but misses. The appeal is turned down. The fielding side doesn't take a review. The umpire reckons maybe it was pitching outside leg. The replays show that it was dead plumb.
Loopy ball on off, played to covers.
Darts it full on off, defended well by covering the line.
Loopy ball on off, pushed to covers for a single.
On the pads, it is nudged to the leg side.
Silly point comes in.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Loopy ball on off, Mendis gets beaten and hits him on the pads.
Loopy ball on off, Mendis comes forward and blocks it.
On the pads, played to the leg side for a single.
The batsman has worked it off his pads behind square.
Serves it full on off, Mendis plays a good solid defense.
On the pads, played to the leg side for a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Dinesh Chandimal to bat next.

OUT! Lyon gets the captain! Tossed up ball on middle, Mathews tries to defend it. The ball lobs to short leg off the inside edge via pads. Burns takes a simple catch and the skipper has to go. Sri Lanka have lost four wickets after clearing the deficit.
Full ball on off, defended neatly.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Serves it on the pads, worked to the leg side off his pads.
On the pads, played to the leg side for a single.
Ball hits the batsman low on the pads.

Decision stay as it is! Darts it fuller on the leg stump, Mathews comes forward and looks to defend it. The ball beats the batsman and hits him on the pads. The appeal is up for LBW straightaway. It is given not out. The review is taken by Australia. The replays show that the ball was pitching in line but was clipping the leg stump. So, the on-field decision will stay.
An LBW appeal is refereed upstairs...
Flatter on leg stump, Mendis clips it towards backward square leg with soft hands.
Loopy on off, Mathews uses his feet and drives it to wide long on for a single.
Drifting in on off, blocked off the back foot towards short leg.
Fuller outside off, swept away to deep square leg for a single.
Loopy on  a length outside off, turns back in sharply to rap him on the pads. Faint inside edge probably as otherwise he was a goner.
Floats it up on a length around off, worked off the back foot to short leg with the spin.
Leg bye. Ball hits the batsman low on the pads. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Full outside off, left alone.
Serves it on off, played to the off side.
The batsman fails to put bat on ball.
Tossed up ball on off, it angles in. The ball beats the batsman and hits him on the pads. Another appeal for LBW but no is the response.
Darts it outside off, left alone.
Tossed up ball outside off, Mathews doesn't offer any shot as he pads it away. The appeal was loud for an LBW but the umpire is not interested. Maybe the ball was not turning enough to hit the stump.
The batsman has been struck on the pads as he looked to play that off the front foot.
Serves a flighted ball on middle, Mathews comes ahead and defends.
Loopy ball on off, tapped to point for a single.
Serves it on the pads, Mendis flicks it to the leg side.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Serves it a bit short on off, Mendis gets back and cuts it through backward point for three runs.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
That was a close call! Tossed up ball on off, it turns back in. Mendis gets beaten in his defense and the ball hits him on the pads. The LBW appeal turned down because maybe it was going down leg.
Tad fuller on off, Mendis pushes it to covers.
Serves it on middle, Mendis strides ahead and fends it.
Darts it on off, played to the off side.
Loopy ball on off, pushed to covers.
The batsman dances down the track and does well to block the ball.
Hurls it on off, awkwardly swept to the leg side for a single.
The batsman works it down the leg side.
FOUR! Mendis plays it fine! Tossed up ball on middle and leg, Mendis gets underneath it and plays a cracking sweep shot through square leg for a boundary.
Loopy ball by Lyon on off, Mathews premeditated for a sweep and plays it to the leg side for a single.
Hurls it on off, defended watchfully.
FOUR! Another edge and runs! Serves it on off, Mendis tries to play at it with soft hands. The ball goes of the outside edge, falls short of the first slip fielder and runs away to the fence.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Darts it fuller on the pads, a play and a miss. Th ball strikes the pads.
On the pads yet again. Mathews sweeps it well this time to the leg side for a run.
2nd Test fifty for Kusal Mendis.
Loopy ball on the pads, Mendis sweeps it well to square leg for a single. That brings up his fifty. Well played by Mendis under pressure.
Darts it full on off, it asks the batsman to drive it but Mathews blocks it.
A loopy ball on the pads, swept to the leg side.
The batsman dances down the track but decides to defend it.
Bowls a short ball on off, played to square leg for a single this time.
FOUR! Swept and swept hard! Loopy ball on middle and leg, Mendis kneels and sweeps hard through square leg for a racy boundary.
Tossed up ball on off, Mendis gets on the top of the ball and blocks it.
Nathan Lyon to bowl now.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Bowls it on off, played to point for a single.
Loopy ball on off, a good solid defense by Mendis to the off side.
Bowls it on the pads, Mathews gets back and works it to fine leg for a single.
Darts it on middle, Mathews off his back foot defends it to the track.
Serves it on off, Mathews plays an awkward shot from outside off towards the leg side.
Length ball outside off, Mendis leaves it for the keeper.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
FOUR! Back foot punch! Full ball on off, Mendis gets back and punches it through backward point for a boundary.
Serves a tad fuller on middle, Mendis plays a textbook defense. A perfect reply to such a ball.
Good length ball outside off, Mendis is not bothered and lets it through.
Full toss on off, Mendis pushes it to mid off.
Drinks are on the field.
Darts it on off, a play and a miss.
Leg bye. Serves it on the pads, Mendis looks to sweep it yet again  but the ball goes off his thigh pad. Leg bye taken.
On the leg stump line, Mendis goes for a sweep but misses.
FOUR! Short and punished! Serves it a bit short and Mendis cashes in. It was crashed through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Some turn there! Serves it on middle, Mendis goes back to play at it but is squared up. The ball takes the edge and falls just short of the silly point fielder.
Tossed up ball on off, Mendis looks to cover drive it but it is miscued to the off side.
Fuller on the pads, Mendis works it down to fine leg for a single.
Peach! Short and on off, Mendis gets back and lets it through.
Full ball on off, pushed to covers.
Good length ball outside off, Mendis shoulders his arms.
Perfect ball, angling away, Mendis tries to play at it but is beaten. Lucky to have not nicked that one.
Length ball on off, defended neatly.
The batsman drives this through the covers.
Darts it on the pads. Mathews flicks it through mid-wicket for a brace.
Tad short on off, pushed to covers by Mathews.
On the pads, swept through the leg side for a brace.
Edged and safe! Serves it on off, Mathews gets an outside edge but it is safe as it goes away from the first slip fielder.
Tossed up ball on off, defended neatly.
Another full and wide delivery outside off. Mendis sees it and lets it through.
Another length ball outside off, Mendis leaves that easily.
Too full and wide outside off, left for the keeper.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Length ball on off, left alone.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Darts it on off, it is pushed to covers.
Serves it on off, defended watchfully.
Tossed up on middle, Mathews misses the line and it hits him on the pads. An LBW is turned down this time. Some pressure on the new batsman.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Angelo Mathews is the next man in.

OUT! O'Keefe gets his man! Darts it full outside off and it skids in. Silva looks to play for the turn but is completely beaten and rapped on the pads. The bowler and the keeper are convinced as they belt out a loud appeal. The umpire is all convinced and gives it out. Silva takes a review and the TV umpire finds it that it was a legal ball, then there was no inside edge and finally it was clipping the leg stump. So, the decision stays out and with that the hosts have lost both their reviews. 3 down are the hosts.
Silva has been given LBW out but he has taken a review.
Floats it up outside off, defended well off the front foot.
PLAY AND A MISS! Almost induced the false stroke! Length ball angled away outside off, Mendis couldn't resist the poke and is lucky not to get a nick there. Eventful over comes to an end.
Good length angled away from outside off, left alone to the keeper.

FOUR! MORE RUNS! Starc goes too straight! Full and drifting on to the pads, Mendis shuffles across and clips it delicately down to the fine leg fence for another boundary. Runs coming a bit freely now for SL as they eat into the deficit which is now only 41.
FOUR! CUT AWAY! Positive intent from Mendis! This was short and wide outside off, the batsman pounced on it and slashed it high over backward point for a boundary.
Good length outside off, Mendis leans into it and pushes it through the covers for a brace.
Fuller on leg stump, worked towards mid-wicket.
Change of ends for Starc.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
That was a long appeal for an LBW! Tossed up ball on off, Mendis looks to defend but misses. The ball hits him on the pads, the appeal was turned down because maybe it going down the leg side.
Serves a loopy ball on off, Silva drives it through covers for a brace.
Darts it on off, Silva steers it to short third man for a single.
Tosses up ball on off, Mendis tries to defend but gets the outside edge The ball goes to the off side for a single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Tad fuller on off, Mendis this time gets the full face of the bat and plays it through covers for a single.
FOUR! Edged and runs! Full ball on off, the ball catches the outside edge and it goes past the second slip fielder for a welcome boundary. Mendis should like to get tighter in his defense.
Bouncer! Short and on middle and off. Mendis ducks to evade it.
Good length ball on off, Mendis defends it watchfully.
Hurls it a tad full on middle and off. Mendis off his front foot plays it to the off side.
Good length ball outside off, left alone.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
On the pads, this time. Silva chips it to the leg side.
Bowls it on off, tamely pushed through covers for a single.
Serves it on off, Silva plays it to covers for a single.
Darts it on the pads, swept to the leg side for a single.
Tossed up ball on off, played to the off side.
Stephen O'Keefe will bowl.
A good seam up ball to end the over. It goes away from the batsman as Silva shoulders his arms.
Hurls a length on off, Silva with his stride forward plays it to covers. Good technique.
Tad fuller on the pads, tucked to the leg side.
Short ball on middle and leg. Silva sees it well and leaves it for the keeper. Hazlewood showing some variations here with his lengths.
Another full ball on off, Silva plays it to covers.
Tad fuller on off, Silva gets forward and blocks it.
FOUR! Edged and runs! Length ball on off, Mendis tries to block it but the ball catches the outside edge and goes through slip cordon for a welcome boundary.
Short ball outside off, Mendis gets back and steers it through cover-point for a brace. Good placement that.
Too wide outside off, Mendis leaves it yet again.
What a bouncer! Short and wide outside off, all Mendis could do is leave that ball.
Silva with some runs this time! Tad fuller on middle and leg, Silva neatly crunches it through mid-wicket for three runs.
Full ball on off, played into the ground.
Good length ball on off and middle. Mendis off his back foot tries to work it down the leg side but gets beaten. A half-hearted LBW appeal turned down. Height was the factor.
Full on off, tucked to mid-wicket.
Perfect length ball outside off, Mendis looks to feel for it but leaves it.
FOUR! Flicked away! Serves it on the pads, Mendis with a cool head over his shoulders flicks it neatly through fine leg for a racy boundary. That was the first boundary of the innings.
Good length ball on off, a good solid block by Mendis.
Some runs! Full ball on off, Mendis plays a cover drive but the ball had no pace on it to reach the ropes. Brace taken.
Short ball outside off, left alone.
Silva does well to avoid that. Short and on off. A good bouncer after a fuller ball. Silva gets down in a jiffy to let that go to the keeper.
That ball held its line! Full outside off, Silva goes for a drive to that one but misses.
Misfield! Fuller on the pads, Mendis confidently flicks it to mid-wicket. O'Keefe dives for it but fumbles and a run is given. He looks in little discomfort.
Hurls it a bit fuller on off, Mendis off the back foot pushes it tamely to covers.
Length ball on off, angling away. Mendis with the full face of the bat plays it to the off side.
Fuller ball on off, angling in. Silva blocks it watchfully.
Perfect length ball outside off, Silva shoulders his arms.

OUT! Starc straightaway in action! Full and angling in delivery. Karunaratne strides forward and looks to block it. The ball is angled in and beats him to strike the pads. The fielding side is asking questions for LBW and the umpire raises his dreaded finger. The southpaw goes for a review. The TV umpire checks for a no ball, looks fine. Then sees the pitching of the ball, it was pitched in line and was hitting the leg stump. The decision stays and Karunaratne has to go.
Karunaratne has been given LBW out but he has taken a review.

The Australian team is out there on the field with Steven Smith leading the way. Kaushal Silva and Dimuth Karunaratne will be the Sri Lankan batsmen. Mitchell Starc will begin bowling for today to finish his over of yesterday's. Here we go....

Pitch Report - Russel Arnold reckons that the pitch will have uneven bounce as it has cracks. It will assist the spinners. To end, it is a typical Sri Lankan pitch with the batsman needing proper defense to survive.

Hello and a warm welcome for Day 3 between Sri Lanka and Australia  at Pallekele. Sri Lanka are out there for their second innings and have already lost one wicket just before rain played spoilsport on day 2. As of now we have a bright and sunny weather and hope for a clear forecast throughout. Also expect full quota of overs. Australia with their lead over the hosts have an upper hand as of now. We will resume with Sri Lankan's batting in a bit. Stay tuned.
...Day 3, Session 1...

Folks, once again we will have an early start tomorrow at 0945 IST to cover up for the overs lost on both days. Hope the weather is good enough so that the cricketing action can go on full fledged. Until next time, it's goodbye from us! Cheers!

Update 1550 IST - Twice in a row this has happened now. The rain gods have shown no mercy and it's continuously bucketing down in Pallekele. PLAY HAS BEEN CALLED OFF ON DAY 2 AS WELL! Sri Lanka did well today to wrap up the Aussies with some sheer class bowling from Herath and the debutant Sandakan. The duo was absolutely thunderous but the tourists still have an upper hand at the end of the day as they gained an 86-run lead and have also sent Kusal Perera back to the pavilion. The rains then had the last laugh to spoil the final session.
Update 1519 IST - Unfortunately, it has started to rain heavily again and the ground is now fully dressed with the covers on. We'll keep you informed as and when there are more developments.

Update 1456 IST - Some good news. Rains have lessened out and there's just a slight drizzle now. The groundsmen have started to clear the water off the covers now. If things continue this way, play will be resumed shortly. Let's hope for the best. Stay tuned for more updates.

An ideal decision has been made by the umpires. Since the conditions aren't looking pleasant, EARLY TEA HAS BEEN TAKEN! More than anyone, Kusal Perera will be kicking himself as had he survived Starc's over, Sri Lanka would have gone into the break with all 10 wickets in hand. Sri Lanka in early trouble. Let's hope the weather gets cleared and we get a full final session. Stay with us for the updates!

Dimuth Karunaratne walked out to bat but has to go back to the dressing room. Not because he's out or something but because the dark angry clouds have opened up and the large a number of groundsmen are sprinting in with huge covers. We have a delay here, maybe a long one.

The ploy of sending Perera up the order has failed for the home side.
